newsitem.title: USA: AEI Nortel in Pacific logistics pact.
newsitem.headline: AEI Nortel in Pacific logistics pact.

text.p: Air Express International (AEI) said it is one of two carriers retained by Canadian-based telecommunications giant Northern Telecom to manages its transpacific logistics business.
In a statement, AEI quoted Nortel as saying that the award reduces the number of carriers it uses on the Pacific from 25 to two. The name of the other carrier was not disclosed.
The two-year agreement will be phased in over the next nine months, said AEI.

AEI will coordinate air and ocean shipping, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution activities for Nortel for traffic moving between North America and the Asia-Pacific, South Pacific and Indian sub-continent regions.
China is not part of AEI's Asia-Pacific coverage area.

AEI said the new contract grew out of a warehousing and distribution venture the forwarder operated for Nortel in Singapore. AEI also manages a programme for Nortel's Europe import-export traffic. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
